senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. שְׁלָה) [to be lax,] to rest, be at ease, careless.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:3">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 3:26">Job III, 26</cite>) <he>לא שָׁלַוְתִּי מעשו וכ׳</he> I was not at ease on account of Esau, neither was I secure on account of Laban.
